entities.name: Query 31-aa peptide
observations: Sequence VAILGAAGGIGQPLSLLMKDDLFNINAGIVK; length 31 aa; calculated molecular weight 3109.68 Da and pI 5.93.

Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt P84209, a mitochondrial malate dehydrogenase reference from Imperata cylindrica; the reference feature spans beyond both ends, consistent with this being a fragment rather than a complete protein.
The short sequence alone is not sufficient to support independent enzyme activity or a complete cellular localization assignment.

entities.name: P84209
observations: Reviewed mitochondrial malate dehydrogenase from Imperata cylindrica.
Catalyzes (S)-malate + NAD(+) = oxaloacetate + NADH + H(+); EC 1.1.1.37; Rhea RHEA:21432.
Annotated to the mitochondrial matrix and homodimeric.
The query sequence is an exact 31-aa match to a region of this reference, with reference chain boundaries extending beyond the queried segment.

entities.name: Mitochondrial malate oxidation
observations: Malate dehydrogenase contributes to mitochondrial NAD+-dependent conversion of malate to oxaloacetate, a reaction associated with central carbon metabolism and the tricarboxylic-acid cycle.
